ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; predominantly low-intensity black and dark-grey pixels cover approximately 98% of the visible surface, with high-intensity white pixel clusters isolated to distal tips and thin linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark-pigmented contiguous surface across both lobes; discrete high-contrast white clusters located at coordinates corresponding to the far-left and far-right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with a wide obtuse angle; depth is approximately 5-8% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations; low-amplitude peaks are visible near the central notch, transitioning to smoother boundaries along the mid-lobe, and ending in high-amplitude, jagged textures at the distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups located on the posterior-lateral edges of both the left and right tips, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine-width, high-intensity linear marks visible primarily on the right lobe, intersecting the dark pigment in various diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense calcified clusters and irregular tissue growth at both distal tips; distinct white linear scarring on the interior surface of the right lobe.
